$comment: Measured desktop values for the Senior-Saving default listicle layout. Authoritative source is tokens.ts; this file mirrors the accepted (non-BLOCKER) desktop measurements for visual-regression baselining.
$lowerPageComment: lowerPage measured 2026-07-03 at 1014x857 (Playwright Chrome, CSS px, overlay scrollbar 0px so content width is 982px not 967px) from live computed CSS + bounding boxes, after document.fonts.ready. Full-page height 10507px. Evidence: reference-desktop.png (full page), reference-desktop-sections.png, reference-desktop-sections-2.png, reference-desktop-footer.png, reference-desktop-disclosure-open.png. NOTE: lowerPage values are coherent with the 2026-07-03 live page, which has DRIFTED from the top-page baseline above (see drift2026_07_03).

sectionWrapper.separator: hr between sections: class 'h-px mt-8 mb-5 bg-gray-200 border-[1.8px]'
sectionWrapper.separatorBox: 3px tall (1.5px top+bottom border), #e5e7eb, full content width

sectionHeading.element: h3 wrapped in <a> linking to the section's offer URL (LINKED)
sectionHeading.fontSizeAtLg1024Up: 27.2px (stylesheet lg: variant — capture viewport 1014px is below the 1024px lg breakpoint)
sectionHeading.numberBadge: ALL 6 headings start with a numbered badge span ('1.'…'6.'): bg #d1d5db (bg-gray-300), paddingX 6px, borderRadius 8px, inline-flex, marginRight 6px, own lineHeight 24.6px (<1024px) / 35.8px (>=1024px)
sectionHeading.anomaly: section 6's heading alone sits inside 'hidden sm:block' with NO mobile counterpart — no heading renders at mobile for section 6; sections 1-5 render at both viewports

sectionImage.margins: 0 (spacing from siblings: 8px below heading, 16px to next paragraph)
sectionImage.heroParity: does NOT match the hero: hero is 2:1 with 8px radius on the img; section images are 16:9 with 2px radius on a wrapper

choiceButton.element: <button> wrapped in a block <a>; inline style background: var(--listicle-cta-secondary-color)

choiceButtonGroup.classes6and3buttons: mt-2 gap-2 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 (1 column at 1014px capture; 3 columns at >=1024px)
choiceButtonGroup.classes2and4buttons: mt-2 gap-2 grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-2 (2 columns at all widths >= grid)

choiceButtonGroup.followUpCta: each group is followed by a full-width button-styled <a> ('flex justify-center items-center gap-2 my-2 text-center' + same button classes), same #f8020e/62px look, 8px above/below

textCta.display: inline within the closing paragraph (18px/30px, py 6px)
textCta.identicalTo: inlineLink — the reference has no distinct final-text-CTA style

legalDisclosureBlock.band: full-width div 'pt-4 pb-4 flex justify-center' on white, between last section divider and footer (a second identical band with an empty paragraph follows)
legalDisclosureBlock.textStart: Disclosure: This website is privately owned and operated. We are not affiliated with…

logo.size: 232.7x40px (h-10 w-auto, same white logo asset as header)

footer.layout: sm:flex sm:items-center sm:justify-between → logo left, links right at >=640px

$driftComment: Desktop verification pass 2026-07-03 (same 1014x857 viewport): the LIVE page no longer matches several already-measured baseline values above. Per protocol the baseline values were NOT overwritten; both are recorded here. Root observations: page font is Inter via next/font (the baseline's 'Arial, Helvetica' matches Inter's Arial-metric fallback), colors are CMS-driven inline styles/CSS vars, several baseline numbers look screenshot-pixel-derived (e.g. 31px avatar, 38px H1) while this pass reads computed CSS.
